entries.title: Psalms 41:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Blessed [is] he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble. {the poor: or, the weak, or, sick} {in time...: Heb. in the day of evil}

words.text: . {the poor: or, the weak, or, sick} {in time...: Heb. in the day of evil}

entries.title: Psalms 41:2
segments: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; [and] he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies. {thou...: or, do not thou deliver}

entries.title: Psalms 41:3
segments: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness. {make: Heb. turn}

entries.title: Psalms 41:4
segments: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 41:5
segments: ¶Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

words.text: of me, When shall he die

entries.title: Psalms 41:6
segments: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; [when] he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].

entries.title: Psalms 41:7
segments: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt. {my...: Heb. evil to me}

words.text: against me: against me do they devise

entries.title: Psalms 41:8
segments: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him: and [now] that he lieth he shall rise up no more. {An...: Heb. A thing of Belial}

words.text: unto him: and [now] that he lieth

entries.title: Psalms 41:9
segments: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me. {mine...: Heb. the man of my peace} {lifted...: Heb. magnified}

words.text: against me. {mine...: Heb. the man of my peace} {lifted...: Heb. magnified}

entries.title: Psalms 41:10
segments: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

words.text: unto me, and raise me up

entries.title: Psalms 41:11
segments: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:12
segments: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

words.text: And as for me, thou upholdest

entries.title: Psalms 41:13
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
